verdict.rationale: Babylon.js's own docs describe a Scene Inspector for runtime debugging and scene analysis, and list optimization under scene management. That is thin first-party support for the profiling half of the story. Nothing in the pack covers ECS, a jobs/worker system, or instancing, so the data-oriented scaling half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented performance profiler, instancing/thin-instance docs, any ECS or jobs/worker path, and hands-on corroboration of scaling heavy scenes.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can profile and scale — a real profiler, plus data-oriented paths (ECS, jobs, instancing) when scenes get heavy
